metricNotes.criticScore: the orchestrator's own critic score of the selected candidate (pre-performance notes, after the plan-only repair loop)
metricNotes.shippedCriticScore: critiqueArrangement on the performed tracks the selected candidate returns — the notes that ship
metricNotes.audioScore: audio critic on the reference-synth render; null when rendering is off
metricNotes.playabilityErrors: constraint-engine errors summed over all candidates (composition + performance)
metricNotes.harmonyScore: 0..100 = 100 x (chordToneShare - clashShare) on the selected candidate's pitched tracks vs the Song Model chords
metricNotes.chordToneShare: percent of pitched sounding time on a chord tone of the Song Model chords (selected candidate)
metricNotes.clashShare: percent of pitched sounding time a semitone from another sounding pitched part (selected candidate); lower is better
metricNotes.sourceHarmonyScore: 1.0's harmonyScore: the critic's harmony dimension, a property of the Song Model, not of the arrangement (informational)
metricNotes.trajectorySmoothness: coherence metric: register/density roughness inside sections + plan adherence (selected candidate)
metricNotes.seamArtefacts: coherence metric: bar-line jumps at the 8-bar window grid beyond ordinary phrase structure (selected candidate)
metricNotes.motifRecurrence: coherence metric: share of each section's melodic cells already heard earlier (selected candidate)
metricNotes.candidateDistance: 100 x mean pairwise candidateDiversity distance over the run's candidates (the production gate's own measure)
metricNotes.legacySectionConsistency: 1.0's sectionConsistency: planner novelty bookkeeping, 100 on every run (informational, one release)
metricNotes.legacyCandidateDiversity: 1.0's candidateDiversity: note-count spread, 50.4 on every run (informational, one release)
metricNotes.renderFailures: candidates whose reference-synth render was infeasible; null when rendering is off
metricNotes.unselectableShare: 100 when no candidate passed the orchestrator's hard-rule gate (selected: null) or orchestration failed, else 0; the aggregate is the share of such cases in percent; lower is better
metricNotes.noteCount: notes in the selected candidate (not a quality metric)
metricNotes.latencyMs: wall time per case (not a quality metric)
